tess_partnerships: quick heads-up: legal + product asked for a concise SI handoff/playbook for the new Dataflow connector (Snowflake + Databricks + Milvus). goal is a one-pager plus 2 example scripts (one for Snowflake MERGE, one for Databricks Delta) we can attach to the marketplace listing. can we sketch it here?

oliver_eng: i can draft the one-pager. what must absolutely be included? auth modes? monitoring hooks?

rachel_pm: core asks from PM: 1) supported auth (oauth/key/kms) 2) expected throughput per instance 3) data residency note (2 lines) 4) upgrade/rollback story for model artifacts.

diego_infra: infra wants: telemetry sampling guidance, partitioning suggestions for large corpora, and a recommended S3/ADLS layout for embeddings. also mention whether kv-cache is persisted for Dedicated.

tess_partnerships: SI wants operational steps and runbook items (smoke tests, perf tests, permission checklist). vikram, can you add the SI checklist items?

vikram_si: yep. minimal checklist: terraform creds, service principal with role X, test dataset with <=10k vectors, smoke-query script, latency SLA check script. i'll add file names and example commands.

oliver_eng: tech details i'm planning to include: manifest_v2 schema link, connector capability flags (streaming_ingest, batch_ingest, incremental_upsert), supported_embedding_types (float32,float16,quantized/int8,base64), default_shard_count and recommended_shard_by (customer_id or date).

rachel_pm: legal-bot asked for a short residency blurb too. legal-bot: please propose phrasing.

legal-bot: Suggested: "Customers choose a hosting region for connector-managed processing. Data residency and retention follow the selected region and contract terms. For Dedicated deployments, additional controls are available via the private deployment addendum."

oliver_eng: example Snowflake MERGE (simplified) to include in the handoff:

```sql
MERGE INTO redwood_vectors.target_table t
USING (SELECT $1:id AS id, $1:embedding AS embedding, $1:updated_at AS updated_at FROM VALUES) s
ON t.id = s.id
WHEN MATCHED AND s.updated_at > t.updated_at THEN
  UPDATE SET embedding = s.embedding, updated_at = s.updated_at
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
  INSERT (id, embedding, updated_at) VALUES (s.id, s.embedding, s.updated_at);
```

vikram_si: and Databricks Delta example for streaming/incremental:

```python
from delta.tables import DeltaTable
# read parquet with embeddings
df = spark.read.parquet("/mnt/embeddings/staging")
deltaTable = DeltaTable.forPath(spark, "/mnt/embeddings/target")
# upsert logic using merge
(deltaTable.alias('t')
  .merge(df.alias('s'), 't.id = s.id')
  .whenMatchedUpdateAll()
  .whenNotMatchedInsertAll()
  .execute())
```

tess_partnerships: perfect. add a small note about vector precision: "connectors accept float32 default; float16 supported on Dedicated; quantized payloads (int8) are accepted but require on-host dequantization, add `quantized: true` flag in manifest."

oliver_eng: will include a manifest snippet with capability flags, example below:

```json
{
  "manifest_version": "v2",
  "name": "redwood-dataflow-connector",
  "capabilities": ["streaming_ingest","incremental_upsert","query_proxy"],
  "auth": ["oauth","api_key","kms_token"],
  "supported_embedding_types": ["float32","float16","int8","base64"],
  "default_shard_count": 8
}
```

diego_infra: operational notes: recommend sharding by customer_id hashed to N buckets, enable compaction window of 24h for delta tables, and set telemetry sampling to 1% by default for Hosted; Dedicated customers can opt-in to 100% telemetry. also include alert thresholds: p99 latency > 250ms or error_rate > 0.5% triggers incident.

rachel_pm: for marketplace blurb i'll write a 1-paragraph summary and attach the one-pager. also will add the pricing dimension note: listing will reference "region" and "tokens/embedding_units" as usage dimensions.
